evaluation: Blind mixed-stream evaluation of frozen shipped detectors.
row_level_note: Event recall and false alerts per normal-driving hour are more operationally relevant than row-level metrics.
simulated_data_limitation: All source data is simulated with idealized sensors and an in-sim driver, not a ROS-driven vehicle. These tests estimate robustness only and do not establish real-world performance.

state_modes.continuous_state: Rolling features and row-to-row state span joins.
state_modes.reset_at_joins: Rolling features and row-to-row state reset at each saved join point.

join_alert_definition: An incident is near a join when its interval intersects two seconds before or after a recorded join point.

category_agreement.interpretation: Diagnostic family agreement only; not attack attribution.
